title: linux-admin consolidated to 80 focused skills
summary: Overlapping micro-skills were merged into canonical Linux administration domains to reduce routing ambiguity and duplicated guidance.
highlights: Reduced the skill set from 101 to 80 without dropping a practical Linux administration domain.
Merged permission, authentication, networking, performance, logging, RCA, security, and architecture overlaps into their parent skills.
Shortened README, agent instructions, metadata, and the expert index.
Maintained agent support remains documented in docs/AI_TOOL_SUPPORT.md.
